This repository contains large normative Markdown documents.

When working here with Copilot:

- Keep `engine-tools-report_progress` checklists short and high-signal.
- Keep final summaries concise and limited to the files changed plus the reason for each change.
- Do not paste large document excerpts, tables, or repository inventories into progress updates or final summaries.
- Prefer referencing file paths instead of quoting document bodies.
- Avoid restating the full repository context unless it is directly required for the task.
